title: Trainstorm Intent Ontology — Objective Store
description: The governed store of learning-objective nodes (obj_...). Owner: L&D / Instructional Design. The intent facet's teaches[] on an atom references obj_ ids in this store. Governed like the roles/records registries: closed for USE (an ungoverned obj_ reference is flagged, never silently accepted), grown only by entry + version bump. Canonical home: cgen/trainstorm-core/ontology/objectives.json. Objectives point SIDEWAYS (requires = prerequisite objectives) and OUTWARD (framework = external competency standard). An UPWARD serves:[goal_id] link is a designed-later additive field, gated on the not-yet-designed goal/outcome node; adding it is a version bump, not a rewrite.

objectives.description: Map of obj_ id -> objective node. propertyNames enforce the governed obj_ prefix.

requires.description: Prerequisite objectives — obj_ ids that must resolve within this store. Empty for a root objective. Referential integrity (every id exists) is checked outside the schema.

framework.description: External competency-standard reference (e.g. CASE). Use 'none' if unmapped.

derived_from.description: Provenance pointer to the source this objective was distilled from.
